adapters.name: openlibrary
adapters.description: Open Library search results as book cards, with covers and subject tags.
adapters.rateLimitNotes: No published hard limit; cache search pages and send a descriptive User-Agent.

adapters.name: themealdb
adapters.description: TheMealDB recipes as cards with images, cuisine, category and instructions.
adapters.rateLimitNotes: Free development key is rate limited; apply for a production key.

adapters.name: arxiv
adapters.description: arXiv Atom entries as paper cards with authors, abstract and categories.
adapters.rateLimitNotes: At most one request every three seconds; identify the client.

adapters.name: tmdb
adapters.description: TMDB movies as cards with posters, genres, ratings and release dates.
adapters.rateLimitNotes: Requires a key; do not ship it in a browser bundle.
